title: Deti hai sada sughra
body:
Deti hai sada sugra mai kaise jiyu baba
Weeran hai ghar mera mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Akbar ne kaha tha ye aavunga tujhe lene
Wada na hua pora mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Rahkar mai watan me bhi lagti rahi pardesi
Koi bhi nahi mera mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tadpati hai ab yaade yaad ate hai maa bahne
Hai baar har ek lamha mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ye kaisi ghadi aayi rulwaati hai tanhaayi
Dushwaar hai ab jeena mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
5.  Har dam hai nazaaro me phirta hai nigaaho me
Asgar ka hasee chahra mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Hai zoaf ka ye alam mai kaapti hu har dam
Is haal me hu tanha mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Rah rah ke rulaata hai dil mera dukhata hai
Ye chand muharram ka mai kaise jiyu baba
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bibi ki azadari barpa hai kamaal ab bhi
Shahzaadi ka hai nawha mai kaise jiyu baba
